description: #130: the ATB gauge layout for slots 1 and 2. From "stats-battle", 240 frames with no input, mark, then 60 more: each candidate turn[i].atbGauge (i = 1 Barret, 2 Tifa) at base 0x800F5BB8 and 0x800F5BBC must have increased since the mark (a gauge that is already full reads unchanged and fails). Signs only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
